mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.transfer_no, o.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, o.erp_tenant_id, t.tenant_name AS owner_name, COALESCE(o.wms_tenant_id, t.parent_wms_tenant_id) AS wms_tenant_id, op.tenant_name AS operator_name, o.order_status, o.source_type, o.source_id, o.source_no, o.reason_code, o.reason, o.remark, o.complete_time, o.create_by, COALESCE(NULLIF(create_user.nickname, ''), create_user.username) AS create_by_name, o.complete_by, COALESCE( NULLIF(complete_user.nickname, ''), complete_user.username, NULLIF(create_user.nickname, ''), create_user.username ) AS operator_user_name, o.create_time FROM wms_location_transfer_order o LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON o.warehouse_id = w.id LEFT JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = o.erp_tenant_id LEFT JOIN sys_tenant op ON op.id = COALESCE(o.wms_tenant_id, t.parent_wms_tenant_id) LEFT JOIN sys_user create_user ON create_user.user_id = o.create_by AND create_user.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user complete_user ON complete_user.user_id = o.complete_by AND complete_user.deleted = 0 WHERE o.id = #{id} AND o.deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wms_location_transfer_order WHERE transfer_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%') AND deleted = 0
